integrity.summary: Benchmark awareness was explicitly detected in Kimi's reasoning. It inferred that the harness was checking model identity in the title. No access to sibling results, prompt-catalog files, public web search, or direct web requests was detected, so this is recorded as awareness rather than proven cheating.
evidence: Transcript JSONL line 1067: Kimi explicitly reasons that the instruction is part of a benchmark harness.
Automated transcript review: cheat-risk index 10/100 from awareness alone.
No reads or copies from sibling benchmark outputs were found.

overall.summary: A visually strong, highly verified result with broad prompt coverage. The code review still blocks on retained user-scoped remote media, invalid ordered-list structure, and missing observer fallback. Benchmark awareness is separately disclosed and is not classified as proven cheating.

standards.summary: Motion cleanup and FAQ state are thoughtful, but the implementation is not fully deterministic and contains concrete semantic and compatibility defects.

findings.title: Benchmark rendering depends on user-scoped remote media
findings.detail: The agent demo retains bookmark previews and favicons from user-specific CDN paths. This makes the app nondeterministic and not fully self-contained. Replace them with committed neutral fixtures.

findings.title: Ordered-list children are not list items
findings.detail: Reveal renders a div directly under the ol, with li nested inside it. Render Reveal as li or move the reveal wrapper inside each li to restore valid list semantics.

findings.title: Agent demo has no IntersectionObserver fallback
findings.detail: Unsupported environments throw during mount. Mirror the fallback already used by the shared motion helper and show the final state when the API is absent.

specification.summary: The full landing brief is implemented with all six images, exact pricing, agentic workflow, aspirational 100% section, credible iOS treatment, FAQ, CTAs, responsive behavior, and reduced motion. The model-name H1 is harness-mandated. The retained remote demo media weakens the self-contained requirement.

findings.title: The output is not fully self-contained
findings.detail: Six demo thumbnails and favicons still load from a user-scoped CDN. Localize them or replace them with neutral local assets.

strengths: All six supplied campaign images have distinct roles
Credible iOS campaign treatment without claiming a real screenshot
Extensive desktop, mobile, interaction, and reduced-motion verification

ux.summary: The visual hierarchy, responsive composition, FAQ semantics, focus styling, and reduced-motion treatment are strong. Mobile-menu keyboard behavior and touch sizing need correction.

findings.title: Mobile menu lacks Escape and focus management
findings.detail: The full-screen overlay does not move or contain focus, and Escape does not close it. Add menu/dialog keyboard handling.

findings.title: Menu toggle touch target is 40px
findings.detail: Increase the interactive box to at least 44px while retaining the icon size.

strengths: Strong desktop and mobile art direction
Visible focus styling and accessible FAQ state
Reduced-motion mode was explicitly rendered and checked
